Amazon Appstore link is broken, for old legacy upgrade key! Amazon Fire tablets workaround for installing your old "OurGroceries Key" upgrade. (Google Play Store must be installed on Fire tablet). On your phone, go to settings--->apps, find "OurGroceries Key", and select "App details in store". (Google Play Store opens.) Use 3-dot menu to share the "OurGroceries Key" link to email. Use the email link on your Fire tablet to open the Google Play Store. Install "OurGroceries Key".
